purpose: Pre-declared plan for auditing visual_map_v2 retrieval and cross-view 3D correspondences, written BEFORE audit results exist.
query_set_A_role: The same 20 decoded RGB ordinals as evaluation_v2_framefix. Used for diagnosis, so any later fix evaluated on them is not a clean held-out result.
query_set_B_rule: Ordinal 225 plus midpoints between consecutive set-A ordinals, snapped to phase 45 mod 90 (same phase rule as v2). Disjoint from set A and from reference ordinals.
query_set_B_role: Not inspected during the audit. Reserved to evaluate any software fix with unchanged acceptance rules. Still same-recording, not independent-phone validation.
oracle_policy: Recorded query poses and query LiDAR depth may be used only after matching, as diagnostic oracles. They are never inputs to retrieval, matching, PnP, or acceptance.

diagnostic_definitions.covisible_point: reference confident 3D point that projects inside the query image with positive depth and agrees with query LiDAR depth within 0.10 m + 5%
diagnostic_definitions.true_overlap_reference: >= 30 covisible points (sensitivity also reported at 15 and 60)
diagnostic_definitions.correct_pose: <= 0.5 m and <= 10 degrees from the recorded query pose; wrong-place = > 2 m

timestamp_prefinding: Before this plan, a timestamp-gap fingerprint suggested decoded ordinal i corresponds to odometry/depth row i+1 for b9dca4993d. The audit must test this geometrically, not assume it.
